interpretationPrinciple: Translate only the observed Pokémon TCG Pocket promotional section. Preserve its asset/copy relationship and breakpoint-specific recomposition without promoting its black panel, 50/50 split, mobile background, typography, or CTA treatment into site-wide rules.

visualIntent.summary: A cross-site digital-product promotion that balances a pale-blue campaign image field against a decisive black explanation-and-action field. Product recognition leads; concise copy and a single external action complete the handoff.
hierarchy: The transparent Pocket logo-and-cards composite is the primary recognition asset.
Desktop gives asset and copy equal 50/50 spatial authority.
Mobile intentionally changes to asset-first/copy-second and uses a dedicated small-screen background.
The black panel is a local contrast anchor for one title, one paragraph, and one CTA.
The white CTA is the only action and exits to the separate Pokémon TCG Pocket site.
brandSignals: desktop equal split and mobile vertical reflow
Kanit italic display heading with PT Sans body and CTA
white CTA with black-to-gold foreground hover

structureRecipe.scope: homepage Pokémon TCG Pocket section only

layers.rule: Use background.jpg for the desktop campaign field and header_bg-small.jpg for the mobile asset field. The mobile asset field is not an arbitrary crop of the desktop image.
Place the independent transparent logo-cards.png composite as the sole primary campaign artwork; do not flatten it with a screenshot or split it into invented layers.
Use an opaque rectangular black field for the title, paragraph, and CTA; desktop occupies the right half, mobile spans full width after the asset field.
Keep exactly one Kanit italic H2, one centered PT Sans paragraph, and one centered white external CTA. Do not add a kicker or secondary action.

interactionRecipes.downstreamRule: Do not claim or implement source-faithful intermediate frames, duration, easing, stagger, or sequence. A Director may omit the reveal or authorize a clearly non-fidelity transition, but it must remain unscored and explicitly labeled as not learned from source.

mustPreserve: desktop background.jpg and mobile header_bg-small.jpg identities
logo-cards.png as one independent transparent composite
one H2, one paragraph, and one CTA
Kanit italic heading and PT Sans body/CTA roles
white CTA with localized black-to-gold foreground hover
allowedVariation: The composite may scale proportionally within its evidenced field.
Text may wrap naturally according to viewport width.
Minor spacing translation is allowed only to retain the observed hierarchy and section boundary.
mustNotReplace: Do not use a source screenshot or section crop as runtime artwork.
Do not preserve desktop 50/50 geometry on mobile.
Do not crop background.jpg as a substitute for header_bg-small.jpg.
Do not add a kicker, second CTA, carousel, card interaction, or decorative overlay.
Do not reproduce the small red Chinese browser-extension overlay.
Do not invent precise entry motion timing, easing, stagger, or intermediate frames.

sectionLocalRules: desktop and mobile Pocket background identities
Kanit italic heading and PT Sans body/CTA hierarchy
white Play Now CTA and its black-to-gold hover
notGlobalTokensOrRecipes: The 50/50 desktop split is not a site-wide campaign layout.
The black panel is not a generic panel, modal, card, navigation, or host-project surface.
The mobile header_bg-small.jpg behavior is not a global mobile-background rule.
Kanit/PT Sans sizing and italic roles here do not authorize global typography changes.
Gold is not inferred as a global hover or active color.
Asset-first/copy-second is not a universal mobile reorder.
The hidden and settled motion endpoints are not a reusable global motion preset.
mustNotInvent: precise motion intermediate frames, duration, easing, stagger, or sequence
Championship Series content inside the Pocket section

unresolvedClaims.impact: Only hidden and settled endpoints are trustworthy; no continuous visual trajectory was captured.
unresolvedClaims.downstreamRule: Keep timing, easing, stagger, intermediate frames, and exact sequence unresolved and exclude them from source-fidelity scoring.

requirementsForDesignDirection: Approve both 1440px desktop and 390px mobile proof surfaces.
Freeze the two responsive background identities and the single transparent logo-cards composite.
Require desktop 50/50 asset-left/copy-right and mobile asset-first/copy-second.
Require the localized CTA hover and real external destination.
Exclude exact entry choreography from fidelity claims unless Evidence later captures a reliable intermediate sequence.
Reject the browser-extension overlay and all site-wide promotion of this section's local rules.
